crossRefs.note: Woe to the wicked! Disaster is upon them; for the deeds of his hands will be paid back to him.
the wicked man writhes in pain all his days, even the number of years that are laid up for the oppressor.
“Yes, the light of the wicked will be put out. The spark of his fire won’t shine.
His bones are full of his youth, but youth will lie down with him in the dust.
Surely you set them in slippery places. You throw them down to destruction.
For they don’t sleep unless they do evil. Their sleep is taken away, unless they make someone fall.
For they eat the bread of wickedness and drink the wine of violence.
These are hidden rocky reefs in your love feasts when they feast with you, shepherds who without fear feed themselves…

translations.web: But the wicked are like the troubled sea; for it can’t rest and its waters cast up mire and mud.
translations.bsb: But the wicked are like the storm-tossed sea, for it cannot be still, and its waves churn up mire and muck.
translations.kjv: But the wicked are like the troubled sea, when it cannot rest, whose waters cast up mire and dirt.
translations.asv: But the wicked are like the troubled sea; for it cannot rest, and its waters cast up mire and dirt.
